meta.notes: A font is a list of glyph providers. A bitmap provider cuts its texture (textures/font/icons.png) into a grid with one cell per character in chars, here one icon on the private-use character U+E000; height is the glyph's height in text and ascent how far it sits above the baseline. Use it in any text component: {"text": "\uE000", "font": "msm_examples:icons"}. Characters this font lacks show nothing, so add a reference provider to minecraft:default to keep the normal letters.
